name: Audioversum ScienceCenter Innsbruck
kurzbeschreibung: The Audioversum ScienceCenter in Innsbruck: An interactive discovery world dedicated to hearing, wonder, and sensory perception with hands-on exhibits.
beschreibung:
Overview

The award-winning Audioversum ScienceCenter is centrally located on Wilhelm-Greil-Straße in the Tyrolean provincial capital Innsbruck (Innsbruck region) at an altitude of approximately 574 meters. Established on the initiative of MED-EL, the globally leading Innsbruck-based pioneer in medical hearing implants, this modern discovery space combines medical technology, contemporary art, neuroscience, and playful science education. Conceived as an innovative science museum, the center explores the human sense of hearing—the remarkable sensory organ that allows spatial orientation, conveys deep emotion, and forms the fundamental bridge of human communication.

Route & Requirements

Across more than 1,000 square meters of exhibition space, dozens of multimedia and hands-on stations invite visitors to experiment, listen, and feel. Among the standout attractions is the Hair Cell Labyrinth: an oversized, walk-through recreation of the delicate sensory cells inside the human cochlea, vividly demonstrating how mechanical sound waves are converted into bioelectrical nerve impulses. In the Scream Sound Box, visitors can test their vocal power in decibels, while at the Sound Salon, binaural 3D audio via high-precision headphones creates astonishing acoustic illusions, making you feel as though you were seated in a real barber's chair. On the virtual Inner Ear Journey, guests use intuitive gesture controls to navigate the inner ear and learn how cutting-edge cochlear implants function. Rotating special exhibitions on topics like optical illusions, robotics, and ambient acoustics complement the acclaimed permanent exhibition 'Adventure Hearing'.

Visit & Arrival

The Audioversum in Innsbruck is open Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00 (closed on Mondays; special hours apply on public holidays). Admission prices (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €11.00, seniors and students approx. €9.00, children and youths (aged 6 to 15) approx. €6.00, children under 6 free; family passes available for approx. €24.00. Holders of the Innsbruck Card receive free admission. Getting there: The ScienceCenter is situated at Wilhelm-Greil-Straße 23, just a five-minute walk from Innsbruck Central Station and Maria-Theresien-Straße. Trams and buses stop right nearby at Bozner Platz and Triumphpforte. Drivers will find parking at the adjacent Bozner Platz and Meinhardgarage parking garages.

Tips

The entire museum is fully wheelchair-accessible and barrier-free; interactive stations are thoughtfully adjusted for wheelchair users and children of varying ages. Download the free digital museum guide to your smartphone upon arrival or borrow an audio guide at reception. A visit to the Audioversum pairs wonderfully with a shopping stroll along vibrant Maria-Theresien-Straße and sightseeing at the historic Triumphal Arch (Triumphpforte).
